title: Solo dev looking for collaborators to help grow my AI-assisted strategy game
author: ExpertGazelle8297
selftext:
I’m the solo developer of Rise of Crowns: Civilizations, a strategy game released a little over a month ago.  
I’ve built most of it using AI, but now I need help improving artwork, characters, animations, new content and marketing.  
I’m working alone with a very limited budget, mostly enough to cover server costs.  
Would anyone be interested in collaborating voluntarily? If the game grows and becomes successful, I’m open to sharing revenue fairly based on contributions.  
I’d love to build something together with like-minded people!  
Game: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hexyntech.warrior](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hexyntech.warrior)
